newsitem.title: USA: Dow stumbles en route to 8,000, tech stocks gain.
newsitem.headline: Dow stumbles en route to 8,000, tech stocks gain.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks rose slightly then eased on Wednesday, with the Dow faltering in its run towards the key 8,000 mark, while technology stocks firmed amid upbeat earnings prospects.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average hit an early high of 7,990, just 10 points shy of the 8,000 mark. It then pulled back to trade off around three points or 0.05 percent at 7,958.

The Nasdaq composite index was stronger, adding around seven points, or 0.48 percent, to 1,492, as bellwether technology stocks like Intel Corp and Motorola Inc rose. The long bond rose 11/32 to yield 6.56 percent.
